query: Which month had the best total attainment across all regions?
corrected_sql: WITH sales_totals AS (SELECT month, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM v_sales GROUP BY month), target_totals AS (SELECT month, SUM(target_revenue) AS total_target FROM read_csv_auto('dataset/targets.csv') GROUP BY month) SELECT s.month, ROUND(s.total_revenue * 100.0 / NULLIF(t.total_target, 0), 2) AS value FROM sales_totals s JOIN target_totals t ON s.month = t.month ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 1

query: What is the average monthly profit for APAC and NA?
corrected_sql: WITH regional_monthly AS (SELECT region, month, SUM(profit) AS total_profit FROM v_sales WHERE region IN ('APAC', 'NA') GROUP BY region, month) SELECT AVG(total_profit) AS value FROM regional_monthly

query: What is the total shortfall across all regions for February?
corrected_sql: WITH sales_totals AS (SELECT month, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM v_sales WHERE month = '2024-02' GROUP BY month), target_totals AS (SELECT month, SUM(target_revenue) AS total_target FROM read_csv_auto('dataset/targets.csv') WHERE month = '2024-02' GROUP BY month) SELECT ROUND(t.total_target - COALESCE(s.total_revenue, 0), 2) AS value FROM target_totals t LEFT JOIN sales_totals s ON t.month = s.month
